title: Old rejected approach
summary: Tried in Q1; abandoned because the assumption about response shape did not hold.

lesson_title: Don't assume uniform response shape across SSR variants
lesson_body: Rule: SSR frameworks ship hydration data in different shapes per major version. Why: cross-version drift broke the prototype. How: detect framework version before hydration parse.

title: Revived approach with framework detection
summary: Re-tries the prior idea after addressing the framework-version drift lesson.
